subject: prd/workbench-ui
statement: The reading room shall reach a usable catalog within 3 seconds of launch and shall answer each navigation or search request within 300 milliseconds at the 95th percentile, on the reference dev machine at a corpus of up to one thousand documents.
fit_criterion: p95 launch-to-catalog ≤ 3s; p95 request ≤ 300ms; p99 ≤ 1s on the fixture corpus scaled to 1,000 docs
